articles.title: China's navy to display new autonomous and aviation tech at the upcoming Zhuhai air show
articles.summary: China's rapidly expanding naval power, particularly its growing aircraft carrier fleet and advanced aviation systems, will be a key highlight at the upcoming 16th China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition. This showcase offers insights into Beijing's strategic defence advancements and its ambitions for maritime dominance, emphasizing its indigenous military-industrial capabilities.

articles.title: Israeli military suicides hit a 16-year high as the IDF downplays the crisis
articles.summary: The Israeli military reported its highest active-duty suicide toll in 16 years, with 23 deaths in the first 11 months of 2026. Additionally, 17 suicides were recorded among former Gaza war soldiers. This alarming trend highlights the critical mental health challenges faced by personnel in active service and veterans globally, underscoring the importance of robust support systems within defence forces.
